_description: Expected MX PDF Inspector CLI output for each bundled test fixture. The runner at run-test-pack.sh inspects each fixture and asserts the tier matches the expected value plus, for the mx-tier fixtures, that every required evidence row passes. Add a new fixture by dropping the PDF in fixtures/ and a new entry here.

fixtures.notes: Gold-standard fixture rendered via mx.pdf.sh from a minimal info-doc markdown. Every signal the CLI inspects for is present: ISO 14289-1 tagged structure, MX XMP namespace, AI provenance payload (schema v2.0, parties[], runRevision), responsible-person identifier.
